messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a marketplace private offer for the HW partner PoC next quarter. They want a short commit with a clear renewal incentive.
Lucas: ok, rough ask from partner? committed $ + SW credits?
Maya: They proposed a 3-month $50k reserved credit to run PoC + SI onboarding. Want a conversion path: if they convert to a 12mo commit within 6 months, give 15% off year 1.
Nina: 15% first-year discount is doable but need floor on renewal T&Cs. Also need to model revenue recognition.
Sam: Legal: confirm we can do a conditional discount tied to conversion event, not retroactive credits. Need clear language: "conversion within 6 months" + definition of "convert" (signed committed contract).
Jordan: HW partner care: they expect an "appliance" SKU bundling option. We should include an HW credit kicker ($10k) if they hit PoC milestones.
Olivia: Channel ops: marketplace private offers can't carry physical HW SKU line items. We can do a marketplace SKU for Redwood credit and a co-terming note in the PO. Partner can redeem credits for HW ordering off-invoice. Need ops sign-off.
Lucas: propose two offer flavors: 1) Short PoC private offer (3mo $50k credit + $10k SI voucher) with conversion path 15% off 12mo; 2) Pilot-to-production ramp (6mo $120k commit) with 10% laddered renewal discount.
Maya: I sketched pricing tiers:
```
PoC Offer: $50k (3mo) -> 15% off if convert to 12mo within 6mo
Pilot Ramp: $120k (6mo) -> 10% off yr1, 5% yr2 on renewal
HW Kicker: $10k appliance credit applied after PoC success
```
Maya: Also need SI integration scope and deliverables attached to the private offer.
Nina: Finance: run sensitivity on ARR conversion (convert rates 20/40/60%). I can push a quick model by EOD if you give assumptions.
Maya: Assumptions: 25% convert to 12mo at avg ARR of $400k/year if converted.
Nina: on it.
Sam: Legal will draft a short addendum template that legalizes the "conversion" clause + credit application rules. ETA tomorrow.
Olivia: Ops question — can marketplace-bot pre-create the private offer draft so Partner Success can review? @marketplace-bot create draft private-offer template:poc_hw_pilot
marketplace-bot: Private offer draft created: https://marketplace.redwood.example/offers/draft/poc_hw_pilot (access: partnerships, ops) :white_check_mark:
Jordan: good — I'll loop in partner PM and SI lead. Need to confirm HW delivery lead times before committing kicker.
Lucas: one more ask — can we reserve a short-term commit SKU for Dedicated capacity if they need low-latency trial? Adds cost but helps conversion.
Maya: okay blocker list: (1) legal addendum, (2) finance sensitivity, (3) ops confirm marketplace redemption path for HW credits, (4) partner sign-off on SI scope, (5) Dedicated capacity SKU availability.
Maya: Meeting to finalize tomorrow 11am PT?
Lucas: :thumbsup:
Nina: confirmed 11am PT, will bring model
Sam: will have draft language by meeting
Jordan: will invite partner PM and SI lead
Olivia: will confirm ops path for HW credits before meeting
marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: Meeting "PoC private-offer finalization" at 11:00 PT tomorrow — invite set.
